text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak inaugurates the new Delta project and gives the go-ahead on the historic day to unleash the project of the century to develop southern Egypt. The first stage of the project includes cultivating half a million feddans of land and establishing housing blocks. The project will add 24 new cities to Egypt's map in the 21st century.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri says history will record the day of the opening of the Toshka canal.
- First day of Ramadan begins; President Mubarak returns to Cairo and exchanges Ramadan greetings with other leaders.
- Minister of Supply and Trade Ahmed Gueily says that there are sufficient basic supplies in the market for Ramadan.
